status: OCI UNMEASURED; execution instructions, not certification
scope: Real OCI hardware; native 1/2/4/8/16/32/64-worker observations and T32/T64 acceptance. Intel N100 evidence cannot substitute.
safety: Use a fresh dedicated worktree and fresh output roots. Preserve host checkout/user changes. No force push, merge, global configuration changes or destructive cleanup.
Do not inspect, print, copy or publish credentials. Ordinary configured authentication only when separately authorized.
Run measurement batches sequentially, without builds/tests/other benchmark batches competing for CPU or memory.

Verify genuine OCI identity and at least 64 available hardware threads/CPU affinity and adequate cgroup CPU/memory limits before claiming 64-thread evidence. Setting RAYON_NUM_THREADS alone is not host attestation.

Record actual OS, architecture, CPU/topology, affinity/cgroup limits, Python and Rust identities. Preserve all raw reports, failed workers and interrupted checkpoints. Do not reuse output names or select only passing repetitions.

inputs.n100_reference_toolchain: CPython 3.11.15, rustc/cargo 1.94.1; record actual OCI identities and require exact baseline/candidate interpreter/toolchain equality on that host
inputs.dependency_versions: maturin 1.13.0, numpy 2.4.6, pandas 2.3.3, plus the unchanged hash-locked transitive inventory

host_receipt_shell_after_preparation: .venv/bin/python -c 'import json,os,platform; a=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)); assert len(a)>=64, "Insufficient available threads"; print(json.dumps({"platform":platform.platform(),"machine":platform.machine(),"cpu_count":os.cpu_count(),"affinity":a}))' > "$ROOT/host-affinity.json"

.venv/bin/python -c 'import json,pathlib; names=["/proc/self/cgroup","/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max","/sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus.effective","/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max"]; print(json.dumps({n:pathlib.Path(n).read_text() if pathlib.Path(n).is_file() else None for n in names}))' > "$ROOT/host-cgroup.json"
host_attestation_note: Obtain a separately redacted OCI instance/shape attestation; inspect the current cgroup path and verify its effective quota, not only the mount-root values. Do not collect metadata credentials or user-data.
preparation_shell: uv run --no-project --python 3.11.15 python -I -c 'import hashlib,pathlib,sys; assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="e0c6624ae3c57e9c6edad88035715cd1ff7f658680e4c90f1a7e9d680a9bc697", "Evidence archive hash mismatch"' "$ROOT/checkout/benchmarks/evidence/issue17-n100-raw.tar.gz"
collection_shell_in_order: .venv/bin/python benchmarks/route_evidence.py run --baseline "$ROOT/base-acceptance/runtime.json" --candidate "$ROOT/new-acceptance/runtime.json" --host oci --threads 32 --cases low ordinary unsorted --output "$ROOT/reports/oci-controls-t32.json"

.venv/bin/python benchmarks/route_evidence.py run --baseline "$ROOT/base-acceptance/runtime.json" --candidate "$ROOT/new-acceptance/runtime.json" --host oci --threads 64 --cases low ordinary unsorted --output "$ROOT/reports/oci-controls-t64.json"

.venv/bin/python benchmarks/route_evidence.py run --baseline "$ROOT/base-acceptance/runtime.json" --candidate "$ROOT/new-acceptance/runtime.json" --host oci --threads 32 --cases packed2 packed10 fused3 --output "$ROOT/reports/oci-domains-t32.json"

.venv/bin/python benchmarks/route_evidence.py run --baseline "$ROOT/base-acceptance/runtime.json" --candidate "$ROOT/new-acceptance/runtime.json" --host oci --threads 64 --cases packed2 packed10 fused3 --output "$ROOT/reports/oci-domains-t64.json"
collection_boundaries: These are bounded subsets rather than one monolithic run. Their DRAFT/incomplete-matrix labels must remain unchanged; review the candidate-bound union without relabeling any individual report as complete certification.

Each OCI non-memory primary subset also automatically collects 40 paired T1/T32 third-call scaling samples. Prespecify oci-primary-t1-t2.json as the first scaling report; retain and review all later automatically repeated scaling observations, including adverse ones. Never choose a passing repetition after seeing results.
The full memory-only command additionally collects actual refused 5m-row ten-key diagnostics at T1/T64. The 512 MiB route payload limit is not a process/fallback cap.
Use explicit per-job wall budgets and retained checkpoints. If a host cannot finish a subset in its budget, preserve it as interrupted; do not overwrite it or present partial samples as 40 pairs.

Baseline count profile exports do not exist. Independent audit below supplies physical-operation evidence, not fabricated baseline phase timings. Unsorted allocator/model bounds remain unknown and must not be replaced with sorted diagnostics.
audit_boundary: Audit-only wheels/overlays must never enter timing, RSS or scaling comparisons. Audit uses exact primary key generation with NaNs deliberately added every 97 float rows; expect 5,000,000 rows / 4,901,309 groups and matching key-byte fingerprints. Require baseline physical hash/output-sort positives, candidate admitted zeros with positive sort-first observation, and public-u32/native-u64 appearance-order parity. Bounded native-u64 is not >2**32-row validation.

unchanged_gates.pairs: 40 adjacent alternating AB/BA fresh-process pairs per case/reducer/cold-or-warm/thread cell; never pool revisions or exploratory pairs
unchanged_gates.bootstrap: 10000 paired draws, seed42, ratio of medians, one-sided nearest-rank U95
unchanged_gates.primary: T32 AND T64 max/count warm ratio <=0.90 AND U95<1.00; cold U95<=1.05
unchanged_gates.control: T32 AND T64 low/ordinary/unsorted max/count cold and warm U95<=1.05
unchanged_gates.domain: Preserve existing driver distinction: T32 packed2/packed10/fused3 max/count cold/warm U95<=1.05; T64 domain observations retained but driver does not enforce a domain-T64 threshold
unchanged_gates.scaling: 40 paired candidate T1/T32 third-call warm measurements for max and count; U95<1.00 for T32/T1 ratio
unchanged_gates.memory: Every isolated candidate worker must satisfy min(pre_input_RSS + normalized_inputs + admitted modeled_peak + 128MiB + 8MiB*threads, 1.10*baseline_median_HWM + 32MiB); modeled admitted route payload<=512MiB and bitmap<=64MiB. Preserve unknown unsorted model as a gap.
unchanged_gates.extra_conservative_local_check: N100 additionally reports warm U95<=0.90; this is not a rewritten binding historical gate

return_receipt: Exact baseline/candidate source SHAs, wheel/extension hashes, dependency/Cargo locks, complete nonempty build transcripts and interpreter/toolchain/host identities.
All raw requests/responses, reports, driver snapshots, dataset manifests/hashes, observer overlays and provenance; preserve failed/interrupted/adverse observations.
Actual per-cell ratios/U95, medians, cold/warm samples, CPU/wall scaling and per-worker RSS/headroom; unresolved diagnostic gaps remain explicit.
No merge or issue17 closure. Coordinator owns the operational Parang request after local review/publication.

optional_mac_authorization.scope: Snowy's immediately preceding grant is current-task/opportunity-only, not standing permission. No remote run or recurring job was launched/scheduled by this lane; no Mac result branch exists.

Any separately authorized Mac evidence must use a dedicated worktree and a separate develop-based results branch, never develop or PR20. Do not inspect credential contents.
optional_mac_authorization.verification: Lane tool-command history and background-job inventory checked; jobs are local route_evidence runs. Existing unrelated ssh processes were observed by PID/parent/elapsed/command-name only, without arguments or credentials; they were not launched or modified by this lane.
